record.paper_title: Recent progress and open questions on the numerical index of Banach spaces
record.original_question: For the set M_m of m-dimensional real normed spaces with numerical index 1, determine the diameter of M_m in Banach–Mazur distance and whether it is asymptotically close to the diameter of the full space N_m of all m-dimensional normed spaces.

evidence.quote: Problem 30. What is the diameter of Mm? Is it (asymptotically) close to the diameter of Nm?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a positive integer $m$, let $\mathcal{N}_m$ denote the set of isometry classes of $m$-dimensional real normed spaces, equipped with the Banach–Mazur distance
$$d(X,Y)=\inf\{\|T\|\,\|T^{-1}\|: T:X\to Y\text{ is a linear isomorphism}\}.$$
For a real Banach space $X$, the numerical radius of a bounded linear operator $T:X\to X$ is
$$v(T)=\sup\{|x^{*}(Tx)|:x\in X,\;x^{*}\in X^{*},\;\|x\|=\|x^{*}\|=x^{*}(x)=1\},$$
and the numerical index of $X$ is
$$n(X)=\inf\{v(T):T\in\mathcal{L}(X),\;\|T\|=1\}.$$
Let $\mathcal{M}_m\subset\mathcal{N}_m$ be the subset consisting of (isometry classes of) those $m$-dimensional real normed spaces $X$ with numerical index $n(X)=1$.

Determine the diameter
$$\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{M}_m)=\sup\{d(X,Y):X,Y\in\mathcal{M}_m\}$$
as a function of $m$, and decide whether $\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{M}_m)$ is asymptotically comparable to $\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{N}_m)$ as $m\to\infty$ (which is known to be of order $m$).
artifact.status_search_result: No source was found that determines the diameter of $\mathcal{M}_m$ in the Banach–Mazur distance or establishes its asymptotic relation to $\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{N}_m)$. Even for the full compactum $\mathcal{N}_m$ the exact diameter is unknown beyond dimension 2, with only Gluskin-type linear lower bounds and John's $m$ upper bound. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Banach–Mazur compactum - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Gluskin proved that the diameter of the Banach–Mazur compactum is bounded below by cn; exact diameter unknown in dimensions > 2.
status_evidence.claim: Even basic diameter questions on the ambient space N_m remain open, and no results specific to M_m were located.

status_evidence.title: Recent progress and open questions on the numerical index of Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing the diameter of M_m as an open problem.
status_evidence.claim: The question is posed as an open problem and no later resolution was located.
